title: Three speakers – code-mixed English / Hindi / Telugu

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning, आइए बैठिए। Please tell me, आज आपको क्या परेशानी हो रही है?
turns.english: Good morning, please sit down. Tell me what is troubling you today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: नमस्ते doctor. पिछले तीन दिनों से मुझे headache और थकान महसूस हो रही है, especially शाम को।
turns.english: Hello doctor. For three days I have had a headache and tiredness, especially in the evening.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: Good morning doctor. నేను ఆమె అన్నయ్యను. Yesterday afternoon ఆమె నాకు phone చేసింది.
turns.english: Good morning doctor. I am her elder brother. Yesterday afternoon she called me.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: ठीक है, पहले patient से सुनते हैं। यह headache लगातार रहता है, या बीच में आराम मिलता है?
turns.english: Okay, let us hear from the patient first. Is the headache constant, or do you get relief in between?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: बीच में आराम मिलता है। Office में screen देखते समय दर्द बढ़ता है, लेकिन rest करने पर थोड़ा कम होता है।
turns.english: I get relief in between. Looking at a screen at the office makes it worse, but rest helps a little.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: ఆమె office నుంచి వచ్చాక rest తీసుకుంది. Dinner తర్వాత కొంచెం better అనిపించిందని చెప్పింది.
turns.english: She rested after coming home from the office. She said she felt a little better after dinner.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: आपकी sleep कैसी रही? Last week काम के कारण देर तक जागना पड़ा था क्या?
turns.english: How has your sleep been? Did work keep you up late last week?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: हाँ, project deadline थी। मैं रोज़ लगभग five hours सोई, और lunch भी कभी कभी skip किया।
turns.english: Yes, there was a project deadline. I slept about five hours a day and sometimes skipped lunch.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: నేను timings note చేశాను doctor. Monday నుంచి late nights ఉన్నాయి, కానీ weekend లో బాగా నిద్రపోయింది.
turns.english: I noted the timings, doctor. There have been late nights since Monday, but she slept well over the weekend.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: धन्यवाद। अब मैं blood pressure check करूँगा। Please relax your arm और सामान्य तरीके से सांस लीजिए।
turns.english: Thank you. I will now check your blood pressure. Please relax your arm and breathe normally.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: ठीक है doctor. क्या मैं अपना symptom diary दिखाऊँ? मैंने headache के times उसमें लिखे हैं।
turns.english: Okay doctor. Shall I show you my symptom diary? I wrote the headache timings in it.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: ఆ diary నా bag లో ఉంది. One minute, తీసి ఇస్తాను. Yesterday readings కూడా అందులో ఉన్నాయి.
turns.english: That diary is in my bag. One minute, I will take it out. Yesterday's readings are also in it.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: हाँ, diary दिखाइए। Examination के बाद हम next steps और follow up के बारे में बात करेंगे।
turns.english: Yes, show me the diary. After the examination we will discuss the next steps and follow-up.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you doctor. मैं details समझना चाहती हूँ, ताकि घर जाकर सही तरीके से notes रख सकूँ।
turns.english: Thank you doctor. I want to understand the details so I can keep proper notes at home.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: Thank you. మీరు చెప్పే instructions మేము రాసుకుంటాము, follow up కి కూడా కలిసి వస్తాము.
turns.english: Thank you. We will write down your instructions and come together for the follow-up.
